groups.algorithm: One whole small FP32 group per owner; K8 Welford lane moments, ordered tail/lane merges, exact binary64 rstd pipeline and software fused affine.
alternatives: Hardware vmadd/vmla are rejected: isolated device probes did not reproduce required IEEE fused rounding.
Full software arithmetic over all groups was deferred because it would affect99M benchmark elements and likely regress performance substantially.
FP64 mathematical moments or approximate reciprocal sqrt are rejected: each failed the unchanged original oracle on retained/adversarial small groups.
groups.ownership: One owner reads each complete group before writing it. Cross-owner output starts are64B aligned. Gamma/beta are immutable shared reads; no output staging in GM and no added global workspace.
groups.reduction: K8 matches the actual frozen CPU RowwiseMoments order; at most16 vectors (128 elements), one chunk, no hierarchical inter-core reduction. Integer software FP32 Add/Mul/Div/FMA preserves each rounding step.
groups.synchronization: MTE2_S after input DMA before scalar UB reads; S_MTE3 after scalar UB writes; MTE3_S before buffer reuse. Existing queue ownership retained; single kernel launch.
groups.task_partition: Contiguous complete-group intervals capped at32 original baseline cores; groupsPerBlock rounds upward to64/gcd(group_elements*4,64). Only final owner has a short group-count tail.
groups.workspace_formula: 0 global bytes. Two512B UB queues=1024B declared UB. Exact-arithmetic automatic arrays/stack are additional compiler-managed scalar storage; actual total stack/spill high-water must be inspected after build.

precision_invariants: Original PyTorch2.10 oracle and original dtype-specific guard/checker thresholds are unchanged.

Key33 reproduces the observed local CPU K8 Welford float32 operation order with integer IEEE round-to-nearest/ties-to-even operations, then binary64 (variance+epsilon), binary64 sqrt/reciprocal and FP32 rstd conversion; exact software FMA computes affine bias and output.
All other keys retain original baseline vector arithmetic unchanged. Sampled component compatibility is not full-kernel correctness, universal proof or speedup evidence.
semantic_invariants: Normalize each N/group over channelsPerGroup*spatial: y=(x-mean)/sqrt(var+epsilon)*gamma[channel]+beta[channel], preserve NCHW flattening.
Each group is independent; baseline computes first/second moments then rereads x to normalize, and affine values depend on channel.
num_groups divides C, epsilon>0, gamma/beta shapeC. Supported dtype half/FP32/BF16; no value-distribution specialization.
Nonempty dimensions required. Dispatch uses only dtype and shape-derived group_elements/group_count, never case identity or tensor values.
Order-independent dispatch: key33 FP32L1..128; key30 L129..4096; keys31/32 L>4096 bygroupcount; lowprecision L1..128 uses original baseline fallbackkey0. Every route remains one named kernel entry.
